issues.detail: Rule names ena[0..2] in conditions but then says bit0=ena[1], bit1=ena[2], bit2=ena[3]; ena has only 3 bits and indexing is inconsistent.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.

issues.detail: Spec does not define ena bit order; contract maps ones==9 to LSB, but spec allows reversed mapping.
issues.spec_evidence: For digits [3:1], also output an enable signal indicating when each of the upper three digits should be incremented.
issues.alternative: Map ena[2]=tens enable (ones==9), ena[1]=hundreds enable (lower two BCD digits==99), ena[0]=thousands enable (lower three BCD digits==999).

issues.detail: Spec says BCD counter but not count direction; contract assumes increment (+1).
issues.alternative: Decrement by 1 each enabled edge, wrapping 0000 to 9999.
